C-FIND-SELECTION-CLIPBOARD.Name: Preserve editor selections and clipboard shortcuts while Find is open
C-FIND-SELECTION-CLIPBOARD.ApprovalBasis: Owner reported keyboard copy/paste failing on the offered Find QA artifact while menu operations work. Standing stabilization repair delegation covers the focused correction without changing release boundaries.
C-FIND-SELECTION-CLIPBOARD.Summary: Selection updates must not replace an active Find query or trigger a delayed render that blurs the editor. Selected text may still prefill Find before it is opened. Native clipboard and menu routing remain unchanged.

Goals.Goal: With Find open, real text selection, keyboard copy/paste and caret input remain usable after the150ms search debounce window. Preserve active query/matches, Markdown/saved state on selection, selected-text prefill before opening, and native menu synchronization.

Constraints.Item: No native shortcut replacement, clipboard shim, global keyboard-layout mutation, command interception, test-oracle weakening, retry/timeout/coverage change, version bump or publication. Keep the prior three accepted table/window scenarios scoped to their original artifacts. Do not infer native acceptance for this repair.

NonGoals.Item: No general keyboard redesign or unrelated data-preservation repair.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A failing unit and real-WebKit reproduction precedes the fix. Unit lifecycle evidence proves shared Find visibility and cleanup; ordinary selected-text prefill remains. Browser tests use real keyboard copy/paste and exact inserted Markdown, preserve selected text/query across the debounce boundary, and retain close/reopen behavior. The unchanged progressive navigation gate passes. Final assertions execute commands and current state/status are rerun before handoff.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-011 editor state and Find UI; existing keyboard browser regression ownership M-012.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Renderer coverage with unchanged floors, production build, real keyboard selection/clipboard cases in Chromium/WebKit, unchanged WebKit-perf navigation and prior table/viewer regression group.
